sources.title: Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct · Models
sources.snippet: For Qwen2.5, we release a number of base language models and instruction-tuned language models ranging from 0.5 to 72 billion parameters. Qwen2.5 brings the following improvements upon Qwen2: Significantly more knowledge and has greatly improved capabilities in coding and mathematics, thanks to our specialized expert models in these domains.

sources.snippet: Qwen2.5 is the latest series of Qwen large language models. For Qwen2.5, a range of base language models and instruction-tuned models are released, with sizes ranging from 0.5 to 72 billion parameters.

sources.title: Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases ...
sources.snippet: The 0.5B size substantially reduces latency compared to 3B, 14B, or larger variants. Q: Does this model support 128K context like the larger Qwen2.5 models? A: No, this 0.5B variant supports 32,768 tokens maximum context length and 8,192 tokens generation.
